title: When we last talked about the Shoemaker family we were discussing Jacob Shoemaker,
excerpt: When we last talked about the Shoemaker family we were discussing Jacob Shoemaker, son of Thomas and his wife, Mary Ambler, from Gwynedd. Jacob and his wife, Joyce Parry, were among the first Quakers to come to Drumore - arriving in 1801 -
